intent: Let a user browse through a set of slides one (or a few) at a time via next/previous controls or dot indicators.
avoid_when: all items should be visible/scannable at once (use a grid or list)
the content is a single linear document (use normal scrolling)
a11y_contract: the root is `role="region" aria-roledescription="carousel"`; each slide is `role="group" aria-roledescription="slide"`; next/previous and dot-indicator controls ship default aria-labels, and the active dot is marked `aria-current`
requires_data: an ordered list of slide contents
